newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to set new Thomson terms "very soon".
newsitem.headline: France to set new Thomson terms "very soon".

text.p: French budget minister and government spokesman Alain Lamassoure told parliament on Tuesday the government would "very soon" announce the new terms for the privatisation of electronics group Thomson SA.

"We have decided to go quickly because a company as important as (Thomson) can not stay too long in uncertainty. That is why we have decided that the government will set out very soon the new terms and timetable for the privatisation of Thomson," he said during question time.
France to set new Thomson terms "very soon" =2
"The government has dediced to continue the privatisation of Thomson, to resume (the sale) on a new basis," Lamassoure said.

Earlier, official sources said the terms could be announced between now and the end of the week while industrial sources said a statement could be due on Wednesday or Thursday ahead of a televised interview with President Jacques Chirac.
Last Wednesday, the government suspended the planned sale of Thomson SA to Lagardere Groupe and Daewoo Electronics of South Korea.
